public.accentStrong.description: Stronger public-site accent for emphasis, contrast, focus, and active navigation.

public.secondary.description: Secondary public-site color for timeline changes, information classification, and quiet supporting paths.

admin.primary.description: Light admin primary for key actions, current selection, and focus.

admin.secondary.description: Light admin secondary for supporting paths and dense information grouping.

admin.destructive.description: Light admin destructive state used only for real danger and recovery feedback.

admin.dark.primary.description: Dark admin primary for key actions, current selection, and focus.

admin.dark.secondary.description: Dark admin secondary for supporting paths and dense information grouping.

admin.dark.destructive.description: Dark admin destructive state used only for real danger and recovery feedback.

public.body.purpose: Noto Sans SC keeps long-form articles, Memos, tag lists, and search results readable.

public.display.purpose: Noto Serif SC carries the literary character of public headings and content.

admin.body.purpose: InterVariable, Inter, and system fallbacks support compact, direct, repeatable admin work.

technicalText.purpose: Code, paths, logs, tokens, and model names remain distinct from ordinary explanatory text.

shadows.name: Public Ambient
shadows.purpose: Soft grouping for public content surfaces.

shadows.name: Public Strong
shadows.purpose: Stronger lift for public surfaces that need additional separation.

shadows.name: Admin Soft
shadows.purpose: Low-noise grouping for admin cards and actionable surfaces.

shadows.name: Admin Strong
shadows.purpose: Additional separation for admin overlays and editor surfaces.

motion.name: Public Ambient

motion.name: Public Interaction

motion.name: Admin Feedback

motion.name: Reduced Motion

components.name: Nature Primary Button
components.description: 主要公开站操作，使用自然绿渐变和轻微浮起反馈。
components.css: .ds-nature-button { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 0.55rem; min-height: 2.75rem; padding: 0.72rem 1rem; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 999px; cursor: pointer; transition: transform 220ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1), box-shadow 220ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1), background-color 220ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1); } .ds-nature-button-primary { background: linear-gradient(135deg, #4e7e60, #294e3a); color: #f7fff8; box-shadow: 0 18px 34px rgba(124, 169, 139, 0.22); } .ds-nature-button-primary:hover { transform: translateY(-1px) scale(1.01); box-shadow: 0 22px 42px rgba(124, 169, 139, 0.28); } .ds-nature-button-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #4e7e60; outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-nature-button-primary:active { transform: translateY(0) scale(0.99); }

components.name: Nature Surface Panel
components.description: 公共站内容承载层，以半透明叠层、有机圆角和柔和阴影分组内容。
components.html:
项目实践

从实际项目中提炼的结构、取舍与实践。
components.css: .ds-nature-panel { position: relative; padding: 1.25rem; border: 1px solid rgba(84, 114, 96, 0.14); border-radius: 32px 38px 28px 36px / 30px 34px 40px 28px; background: linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.88), rgba(252, 253, 251, 0.78)); box-shadow: 0 24px 60px rgba(95, 122, 108, 0.14); color: #24352d; transition: transform 260ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1), border-color 260ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1), box-shadow 260ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1); } .ds-nature-panel:hover { transform: translateY(-2px); border-color: rgba(84, 114, 96, 0.22); box-shadow: 0 24px 70px rgba(74, 98, 86, 0.2); } .ds-nature-panel:focus-within { outline: 2px solid #4e7e60; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-nature-panel h3 { margin: 0 0 0.75rem; font: 600 1.25rem/1.4 "Noto Serif SC", serif; } .ds-nature-panel p { margin: 0; color: rgba(36, 53, 45, 0.68); line-height: 1.75; }

components.name: Nature Accent Chip
components.description: 轻量标签，用于内容分类和继续探索路径。
components.css: .ds-nature-chip { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.35rem; padding: 0.35rem 0.72rem; border: 1px solid rgba(84, 114, 96, 0.14); border-radius: 999px; background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.28); color: rgba(36, 53, 45, 0.68); font: 600 0.8rem/1.2 "Noto Sans SC", sans-serif; } .ds-nature-chip-accent { border-color: rgba(124, 169, 139, 0.28); background: rgba(78, 126, 96, 0.14); color: #4e7e60; } .ds-nature-chip-accent:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #4e7e60; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Nature Input Shell
components.description: 公共站搜索和筛选输入，保持内容优先的柔和边界与明确焦点。
components.css: .ds-nature-input-shell { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.7rem; min-height: 3.25rem; padding: 0.75rem 1rem; border: 1px solid rgba(84, 114, 96, 0.14); border-radius: 18px 20px 16px 22px / 18px 18px 22px 18px; background: rgba(252, 253, 251, 0.78); color: rgba(36, 53, 45, 0.68); } .ds-nature-input-shell:focus-within { border-color: rgba(78, 126, 96, 0.42); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(78, 126, 96, 0.12); } .ds-nature-input-shell input { min-width: 0; flex: 1; border: 0; outline: 0; background: transparent; color: #24352d; font: 400 1rem/1.5 "Noto Sans SC", sans-serif; }

components.name: Playbook Resource Browser
components.description: Playbook 公开资源浏览器，在宽容器中展开文件树、阅读视图和源码视图。
components.css: .ds-playbook-resource-browser { color: #24352d; } .ds-playbook-resource-browser h2 { margin: 0; font: 600 1.5rem/1.4 "Noto Serif SC", serif; } .ds-playbook-resource-layout { display: grid; min-width: 0; margin-top: 1rem; border-block: 1px solid rgba(84, 114, 96, 0.14); } .ds-playbook-resource-layout aside { min-height: 44px; padding: 0.75rem; border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(84, 114, 96, 0.14); color: rgba(36, 53, 45, 0.68); font: 600 0.8125rem/1.5 "Noto Sans SC", sans-serif; } .ds-playbook-resource-layout pre { min-width: 0; margin: 0; padding: 1rem; overflow: auto; background: transparent; color: #24352d; font: 400 0.8125rem/1.75 ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, monospace; } @media (min-width: 40rem) { .ds-playbook-resource-layout { grid-template-columns: 12.5rem minmax(0, 1fr); } .ds-playbook-resource-layout aside { border-right: 1px solid rgba(84, 114, 96, 0.14); border-bottom: 0; } }

components.name: Admin Status Card
components.description: 后台状态承载层，以低噪声 surface、清楚文字和可比较的结果表达任务状态。
components.css: .ds-admin-card { display: grid; gap: 0.35rem; padding: 1rem; border: 1px solid oklch(88% 0.018 88); border-radius: 1.25rem; background: oklch(99% 0.008 88); color: oklch(29% 0.026 252); box-shadow: 0 12px 28px oklch(57% 0.04 252 / 0.16); } .ds-admin-card-label { color: oklch(49% 0.026 252); font: 600 0.75rem/1.4 InterVariable, Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-admin-card strong { color: oklch(58% 0.125 154); font: 600 1rem/1.5 InterVariable, Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-admin-card:focus-within { outline: 2px solid oklch(64% 0.12 224); outline-offset: 2px; }

narrative.overview:
创意北极星是“数字温室”：公开站像一个安静、柔和、可漫游的个人内容空间，后台像内容养护台，帮助作者整理、同步、审核、配置和恢复系统状态。默认 register 是 product，因此设计必须先服务任务完成，再表达个人气质。

公共站采用 Nature Interface。它固定为当前公共站的长期方向：自然色、柔和半透明 surface、有机圆角、时间线节奏、轻量 ambient layer，以及 light、dark、system 三态主题。文章、Memos、标签、搜索和项目都应保持读者能继续探索的路径。

后台采用 Soft UI 内容养护台。它不参考旧后台的样式、排版或布局，而以柔和 surface、大圆角、低饱和色、清楚状态、稳定操作反馈和宽屏工作区承载写作、审核、同步、计划任务和 AI 配置。
keyCharacteristics: 后台采用 Soft UI 内容养护台。
跨表面的共同点是对比清楚、状态稳定、语义一致。
组件使用原则是避免卡片套卡片。
dos: 让内容和状态先被看懂。用清楚标题、可辨状态、稳定布局和明确操作反馈组织页面。
公共站保持数字温室方向。使用柔和自然色、半透明 surface、时间线节奏和轻量动效，但不要遮挡内容。
后台保持安静控制台方向。优先可扫读表格、明确筛选、状态徽章、错误说明和恢复操作。
保持 light、dark、system 主题一致性，并确认减少动态偏好下仍可理解页面结构。
donts: 把个人博客做成通用 SaaS 营销页、社交信息流或默认 AI 产品视觉。
参考旧后台的样式、排版或布局；后台的新视觉重点是 Soft UI 触感、任务、状态和结果。
用颜色作为唯一状态表达；状态必须有文本、图标、位置或结构上的辅助。
新增卡片套卡片、过强阴影、过度渐变、不可解释动效或只为装饰存在的图形层。
